'''R6''', affectionately called '''Arsix''' by those who knew him, was a [[R6-series astromech droid]] owned by [[Jaden Korr]] in the time following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He served as astromech droid to Korr's [[Far Wanderer|Z-95 Headhunter]] on his mission to [[Fhost]] in [[41 ABY]]. When Korr traveled to the [[Frozen moon]] in the [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|UR-2212-GR system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] aboard [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] with its crew, [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]], R6 was ordered to remain behind, hidden in Fhost's system, and to report to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] if Korr did not return within two weeks.<ref name="Cross">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
